description:
Work as a member of a software development team as a full stack developer focusing on web browser based UI/UX .   
 Will occasionally need to support development of server-side components.   
 Follow an Agile Scrum and Sprint based development process and demonstrate periodic testable features.   
 Integrate automated testing into products developed.   
 Work with distributed development teams for development and testing.   
 Work with QA, DevOps and Product Support teams to ensure quality, deployment and support of the product.   
 Follow best practices.   
 Required Skills/Experience   
 BS degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering or related area   
 Relevant industry experience (6+ years)   
 Experienced UI developer with passion for creating intuitive and pleasing user interfaces   
 Experience developing scalable front-end user interfaces using AngularJS, HTML5, CSS3, Javascript and JQuery.   
 Experience developing server side components in Java, Spring and Hibernate   
 Experience in developing Restful APIs   
 Experience with maven, eclipse, git, Jira and Confluence.   
 Experience in web servers like Apache, Tomcat.   
 Knowledge of application containers like Docker.   
 Unix/Linux OS experience.   
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills   
 Desired Skills/Experience   
 Master’s Degree (CS or equivalent)   
 Experience using test automation tools such as Seleinum or Grunt 


 AngularJS, HTML5, CSS3, Javascript and JQuery. 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
